status_definitions.production_live: Publicly reachable and operated by an automated production workflow.
status_definitions.published_static: Published and usable as static files or generated pages; not a hosted transactional service.
status_definitions.feedback_informed: Documented project-specific outside feedback has materially informed the implementation; this does not imply endorsement or peer review.
status_definitions.integration_ready: A public, tested integration surface is available for independent use.
status_definitions.verifiable_prototype: A complete public implementation and verifier exist; public-chain deployment is not required for local or browser verification.

capabilities.name: Public evidence archive
capabilities.claim: A public static archive exposes 10,000 canonical records, institution pages, source metadata, limitations, and correction routes.
capabilities.claim_boundary: Record count measures published documentation, not incident prevalence, school quality, safety, or independent verification.

capabilities.name: Certification and cell-level provenance
capabilities.claim: Deterministic gates internally certify 3,629 records; 6,138 remain awaiting review, including the source-family-checked expansion lane.

metrics.label: ED rows with matched workbook provenance

capabilities.claim_boundary: Certification is a deterministic support-and-provenance gate. It is not equivalent to completed human review or outside validation.

capabilities.name: Research exports and static API
capabilities.claim: Snapshot-bound JSON, CSV, research exports, schemas, and versioned static API files are publicly downloadable.
capabilities.claim_boundary: The v1 API is a static public-data interface, not a continuously queried application server.

capabilities.name: CEL Signals accountability engine
capabilities.claim: An autonomous engine compiles evidence-bounded Signals, publishes to Bluesky, exposes RSS/JSON, and persists distribution state with safety and withdrawal controls.
capabilities.claim_boundary: Operational publication does not itself demonstrate reporting reuse, institutional response, audience conversion, or other downstream impact.

capabilities.name: External feedback and review infrastructure
capabilities.claim: Six documented, project-specific external feedback contributions informed CEL's methodology, source framing, claim boundaries, researcher onboarding, and newsroom usefulness.
capabilities.claim_boundary: The documented contributions are private feedback, not endorsements, formal peer review, organizational partnerships, or independent validation of CEL records.

capabilities.name: Partner syndication and outreach
capabilities.claim: CEL publishes a copy-ready embed, documented JSON/RSS feeds, and a machine-readable partner manifest backed by duplicate-controlled outreach machinery.
capabilities.claim_boundary: Integration readiness means the public assets work as documented. It does not imply a partnership, adoption, citation, or impact outcome.

capabilities.name: ProofGraph protocol
capabilities.claim: CEL compiles every public record into a typed evidence graph with hashed nodes and edges, a per-record Merkle root, snapshot-wide inclusion proof, browser verifier, and challenge-capable Solidity registry.
capabilities.claim_boundary: Hash consistency and Merkle inclusion prove artifact integrity, not factual truth, independent review, decentralization, permanence of source material, or third-party use.
